initial_trees: Corresponding fixed forest-mean-distance decoder outputs, inferred from observed detected features. No true topology or truth-derived root.
topology: Compress only degree-two internal nodes into positive integer-length edges; topology and observed leaves remain fixed. No edge contraction, new branching, NNI, subtree moves, or alternative topology search.
edge_objective: Composite sum over roster pairs of log(sum of frozen model P(label) over labels with the inferred path meiosis count). Probability floor 1e-12, matching frozen root score. Pair dependence is acknowledged; this is not an independent likelihood or calibrated posterior.
edge_moves: At each step enumerate +/-1 changes to one edge, lengths1..10, all pair distances2..10. Accept the highest strictly improving score (>1e-12) whose expanded tree has at least one accepted-label rooting. Tie order fixed by sorted inferred edge endpoints then -1 before +1. Never revisit an accepted length vector.
root_policy: After edge optimization enumerate all accepted roots and apply the frozen full-label composite log score and tie rule. Root pruning only excludes roots with an observed leaf farther than five meioses: such a root necessarily violates the accepted label domain because every internal root has at least two leaf-containing branches. This is a logical domain constraint, not midpoint/generation/age preference.
uncertainty: Retain all valid-root ambiguity conditional on chosen edge lengths. This does not cover other length assignments or other topologies. No calibrated root-probability claim.
data: Same eight explicitly reused development cohorts. Frozen models, calibration, previous results, old reserved confirmation and nested qualification remain unchanged.

tests.checks: Known integer-length correction preserves topology; pair/sample/edge-order invariance; move cap; cycle/leaf contract; pruned roots equal unpruned accepted roots on25 random trees; previous phase/component/model-distance invariants retained.
